southern-peru-ilo-smelter-toquepala.conditions_add: Minutes of the US National Advisory Council record that its no-objection action of 1 November 1954 capped the Export-Import Bank loan for the Toquepala project at US$100 million and limited the bank's share to “not more than a 50-50 basis” of the financing. The terms put to the council were that “the Bank's loan would be the senior obligation of the borrower” and that “the borrower would be required to guarantee completion of the project to the Bank”, with principal repaid over 15 years starting five years after the loan; the minutes note the applicant had not said whether it would accept the completion guarantee (US Department of State, FRUS).
